summary: Verified QSO logbook auto-migration and Paste ADIF modal. Backend startup migrated 14ABC564 from radioamateur to CB (log confirms '1 moved to CB, 0 moved to Radioamateur'). All 4 backend API tests PASSED and all 8 frontend test items PASSED.

test_results.backend_startup_migration_log: PASS - 'QSO logbook migration: 1 moved to CB, 0 moved to Radioamateur' present in backend logs
test_results.ham_stats_total: PASS - GET /api/qso/stats/total?logbook=radioamateur -> total_qsos=10, no CB callsigns
test_results.ham_qso_list_excludes_14ABC564: PASS - Ham list contains only amateur callsigns (TEST1, DL1AB, EA3BCD, G4XYZ, F4ABC, F6TEST, F4MVD)
test_results.frontend_ham_view_no_cb: PASS - Radioamateur logbook view does NOT contain '14ABC564'
test_results.frontend_cb_view_shows_cb: PASS - After switching logbook-selector to 'cb', view contains '14ABC564'
test_results.frontend_import_buttons_visible: PASS - Both import-adif-btn (label) and paste-adif-btn visible after scrolling
test_results.frontend_paste_modal_opens: PASS - Clicking paste-adif-btn opens paste-adif-modal with textarea, IMPORT (paste-adif-submit) and CANCEL buttons
test_results.frontend_paste_modal_cancel: PASS - Clicking Cancel closes the modal

critical_code_review_comments: Migration runs on every backend startup and scans all QSOs unconditionally - acceptable for small dataset but consider making it idempotent-safe via a one-time migration flag if QSO count grows large.
Ham stats endpoint returns total_qsos=10 but total_callsigns=7 (some duplicates like DL1AB, F4ABC, F6TEST appear multiple times) - by design, informational only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is Bearer token via access_token in login response body (no auth cookie set - only cloudflare __cf_bm cookie). Add Authorization: Bearer <token> header for API tests. Logbook-selector on dashboard is a <select> element with values 'radioamateur' and 'cb'. Paste ADIF modal has data-testids: paste-adif-btn, paste-adif-modal, paste-adif-textarea, paste-adif-submit. Cancel button matched by role name='Cancel'.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verification, no bugs found
